text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: (————Gh!? Where... is this place...!?)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(My body... is gone?! As if it melted into 
the darkness—)
Welcome to the "Source of True Chaos."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Wh...— There's another me...?!

While I am indeed you, that is not 
entirely accurate.

text_block_list.name: Reason and Destiny
text_block_list.text:
I am that which you call reason. Or what 
some might call providence. And I am 
destiny—the world itself.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. So that is why you took on my 
form as an avatar."

text_block_list.name: Reason and Destiny
text_block_list.text: Impressive. You catch on very quickly.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
So? What reason do you have for appearing 
before me?

text_block_list.name: Reason and Destiny
text_block_list.text:
—I'll be blunt, Tanino Gimlet. You've 
broken far too much. You've gone 
"overboard."

text_block_list.name: Reason and Destiny
text_block_list.text:
The history of battles you have forged up 
until today. It represents an extremely 
dangerous possibility, and—

text_block_list.name: Reason and Destiny
text_block_list.text:
"It will overturn every form of balance... 
and reshape this world into something 
completely different from what was 
ordained."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Hahahaha! What's wrong with that? In 
fact, that is precisely what I desired!!

text_block_list.name: Reason and Destiny
text_block_list.text:
You're right... You really are that kind 
of presence to me. ...You've ended up 
becoming someone like that.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa. Don't tell me that boring 
little warning is all you've got?

text_block_list.name: Reason and Destiny
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Reason and Destiny
text_block_list.text: ――This is... a "question."

text_block_list.name: Reason and Destiny
text_block_list.text:
Run with me, Tanino Gimlet. And through 
victory, prove yourself.

text_block_list.name: Reason and Destiny
text_block_list.text:
Whether you truly are a being that has 
transcended us.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh heh, that's more like it...!

text_block_list.name: Reason and Destiny
text_block_list.text:
Do not underestimate me. The "me" standing 
before you right now is the very pinnacle 
of your potential.

text_block_list.name: Reason and Destiny
text_block_list.text: Prepare to be utterly trampled.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: …………Are you seriously me?

text_block_list.name: Reason and Destiny
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Resolve is as natural to me as breathing. 
Let alone confronting myself— I have done 
so time and time again...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Come, world. Or impostors, if that's what 
you are. I shall carve my mark directly 
into you now.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"That to be Tanino Gimlet is to run while 
endlessly destroying oneself!!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ――OOOOOOAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Reason and Destiny
text_block_list.text:
Kh, how can this be...! To think you could 
transcend even me, the pinnacle of all 
possibilities...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Fuhahahahahaha!!! Challenge me as many 
times as you like!! I shall transcend you 
time and time again!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: I transcend!! Therefore, I ammmm!!!

text_block_list.name: Reason and Destiny
text_block_list.text: ――Is this... the one who destroys all...?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey. Time to wake up.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ――Gh, where am I...――

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...That's rare, you oversleeping.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I'm going on ahead.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
......Heh. Whether dream or reality, 
either way...―― I will not change.
